patches.name: mwnet_probe_rng_isolation
patches.scope: Wrap the otherwise unused global-CPU randperm probe in fork_rng.
patches.evidence_scope: Call-site delta only; the exact runner already contains a separate isolated arm.
patches.release_digest_rule: If the public copy redacts its author-local default path, PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json records the released base bytes and scripts/verify_repair_patches.py recomputes the released applied digest.

patches.name: bhn_test_loader_generator
patches.scope: Give the test loader its own deterministic torch.Generator; its iterator obtains a base seed even when evaluation is unshuffled.
patches.evidence_scope: Single contrast line only; the historical four-arm harness also used documented common portability, determinism, and state-dump changes.

patches.name: dividemix_gmm_random_state
patches.scope: Pin GaussianMixture random_state at the witnessed call site.
patches.evidence_scope: Configuration contrast, not a no-op isolation proof: it changes GMM initialization as well as global NumPy stream consumption.

verification.release_note: Released-copy base and applied digests must be evaluated on the extracted anonymized files; historical-original digests remain unchanged provenance claims.
